planning.description: Planning agent that analyzes user requests and routes to appropriate specialist agents

orchestrator.description: Orchestrator that creates focused request subsets for each specialized agent

customer-service.description: Customer service agent handling support, returns, complaints, and account issues

product-specialist.description: Product specialist agent providing product information, specifications, and recommendations

promotion-specialist.description: Promotion specialist agent handling discounts, deals, and special offers

feedback-handler.description: Feedback handler agent processing customer reviews, ratings, and suggestions

synthesizer.description: Response synthesizer that combines specialist outputs into final user response
